# JURNL SAFE TO SPEND family: Parent → Child Derivation

**Sprints:** `P0.JURNL.PARENT-CHILD.VISUAL-DERIVATION.PROTOCOL1` + `P0.JURNL.CHECK-PURCHASE.PAY-WITH-DRAWER.MATCH-CATEGORY-DRAWER1`
**Protocol:** `docs/studioos/visual-authority-development/PARENT_CHILD_DERIVATION_PROTOCOL.md`
**Source of truth:** `shared/studioos-visual-authority/projects/jurnl/safe-to-spend-family.ts`. The JSON and TXT files here are generated by `npx tsx scripts/studioos/jurnl-parent-child-derivation-export.ts`.

## The family (`SAFE_TO_SPEND_FAMILY.json`)

| Level | Screen | Expression | Visual authority |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parent | SAFE TO SPEND | full page | IMAGE 1 (founder-held); the live route reconstructs it |
| Direct | WHY THIS NUMBER | full page | to derive (the runtime page is information only) |
| Direct | CHECK A PURCHASE | full page | approved CHECK A PURCHASE screen (founder-held). Derives from SAFE TO SPEND, not from ACCOUNT |
| Direct | ACCOUNT | full page + drawer (siblings) | to derive |
| Secondary | SELECT A CATEGORY | drawer | approved (founder-held). The sizing template for every selection sheet in this flow |
| Secondary | PAY WITH / SELECT AN ACCOUNT | drawer | current version (founder-held). It must share SELECT A CATEGORY's sizing system |

The JURNL constants are:

- **Brand:** PLAN TODAY. GROW FREELY.
- **Type:** uppercase only, serif display over spaced uppercase support text.
- **Logo:** the decorative lockup built from the official asset.
- **Shell:** the dock, the world behind the UI, and no device chrome.
- **Ratio:** about 0.46. The founder captures are 402×874 and the runtime canvas is 393×852. No bands.

## PAY WITH / SELECT AN ACCOUNT drawer (`PAY_WITH_DRAWER_SPEC.json`)

- **Copy:** the title is SELECT AN ACCOUNT. The supporting line is CHOOSE THE ACCOUNT YOU WANT TO USE FOR THIS PURCHASE.
- **Accounts and their pictures:**
  - CHECKING: ledger and brass pen on a travertine desk
  - SAVINGS: sea horizon through an arch
  - CREDIT CARD: ivory embossed card on marble
  - DEBIT CARD: sage card and leather wallet
  - CASH: folded notes in a marble bowl
  - JOINT ACCOUNT: two espresso cups on a stone ledge
- **Structure:** the handle, centered title, centered supporting line, close button, tile grid and labels all follow SELECT A CATEGORY.
- **More accounts** continue the same grid. Tiles never shrink.
- **Status: waiting for the three founder images.**
  - The approved CHECK A PURCHASE screen.
  - The approved SELECT A CATEGORY drawer.
  - The current SELECT AN ACCOUNT drawer.
  - None of them is in the repository. The category drawer's sizes are measured from its image, then the new drawer is checked against them with `checkSiblingSheets`.

## Brief (`PAY_WITH_DERIVATION_BRIEF.txt`)

A ready-to-use generation brief. Attach the three images in the order it lists. It is 298 words with 5 negatives, inside the prompt budget.

It asks for 8 exact strings, more than a generator renders reliably. After generation, check CREDIT CARD, DEBIT CARD, CASH and JOINT ACCOUNT letter by letter.
